customer "C-EXTRA-TOO"
  name: "Another Extra Text Customer"
  currency: CAD
  extra_text1: "Portal: portal.example.test/other"
  extra_text2: "Net 15 by agreement"

# A second invoice, to a *different* customer, so a whole-book run renders
# more than one page and the two owner blocks do not say the same thing.
#
# Both halves matter. What the seller's block can hold is a property of the
# report, not of the invoice, so a page that cannot hold the registration
# numbers cannot hold them for either of these — one sentence, not two. The
# owner's block is per customer, so a sink keyed on the sentence rather than
# on the report and the block would collapse the first and repeat the second
# once per customer. With one customer on both invoices that is invisible.
invoice "INV-EXTRA-002"
  customer_id: "C-EXTRA-TOO"
  currency: CAD
  date_opened: 2026-01-06
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-06
    description: "More consulting"
    action: "Hours"
    account: "Income:Sales"
    quantity: 2
    price: 100
    taxable: false
    tax_included: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-06
    due: 2026-02-06
    ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
    memo: "Invoice INV-EXTRA-002"
    accumulate: true
